sentences.text: For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Ram Naresh Ray
2 21-07-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner is in custody since 11.10.2022 in connection with Kahalgaon (Ghogha) P.S. Case No. 666 of 2022 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 376/323/504/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. As per the prosecution story, the petitioner established physical relation with the alleged victim on the promise of marriage.
4. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the girl is a major.
5. In view of the aforementioned facts and circumstances, let the petitioner above named be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand) Patna High Court CR.

No.37800 of 2023(2) dt.21-07-2023 with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, Bhagalpur in connection with Kahalgaon (Ghogha) P.S. Case No. 666 of 2022.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) Saif/-
